reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: syncRoles is a live Express route registered at index.ts:68 (non-test caller). Gate 2: BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json defines no trust_assumptions — no trusted entry point to match against. Gate 3: src/api/rolesSync.ts is explicitly in scope. Code confirms the spec violation: addRoleToMember (discord.ts:98-100) swallows exceptions and returns false, but syncRoles discards the return value at L158 then unconditionally runs the removal loop — if the add fails, the member loses all status roles while the API returns { success: true }. A second deterministic path exists when memberData.status ∉ {0,1,2}: targetStatusRoleId stays null, the add block is skipped entirely, and the removal loop strips all status roles. Classified CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL because the primary exploit requires authenticated API access plus a specific Discord role-hierarchy misconfiguration; the invalid-status path is deterministic but depends on attacker-controlled DB write. MEDIUM retained — impact is bounded to per-member channel-access loss.
